debug.empty_hint: Switch to Screenshot Debug mode in the sidebar, upload screenshots, then click Analyze Screenshots.

sidebar.demo_help: Use synthetic CS2 match data — instant, no video needed.
sidebar.upload_help: Select a CS2 first-person POV recording (up to 2 GB). 16:9 (1920×1080) recommended.
sidebar.sample_fps_help: Sampling rate for flash, scope and view signals. Round HUD stays at 2 FPS so high rates do not repeat slow parsing.
sidebar.sampling_strategy: Visual effects: {fps} FPS · round HUD: 2 FPS · score OCR: every 2 seconds
sidebar.player_filter_help: Only analyze frames from your POV. Skips spectating after death.
sidebar.player_name_help: Optional game HUD player name. Video watermarks and creator IDs are ignored.
sidebar.ocr_help: Read scores via colour detection. More stable than timer-based.
sidebar.ocr_automatic: Score OCR is automatic and only reads the native CS2 scoreboard.
sidebar.yolo_help: Use the optional CS2-specific model to distinguish T/CT and locate actual enemy contacts. A GPU is strongly recommended.

run.personal_combat_unavailable: Personal kills and deaths are unavailable until native CS2 HUD signals can be attributed reliably; video watermarks are ignored.
run.personal_kills_unavailable: Personal kills remain unavailable. Deaths are counted only after sustained disappearance of the native health HUD; video watermarks are not used.
run.personal_kills_conservative: Personal kills are a conservative lower bound: only events supported by POV fire, an enemy engagement window, and the native local-kill highlight are counted; watermarks and player names are ignored.
run.personal_kills_native: Personal kills are attributed from CS2's native local-kill highlight. Native death attribution is unavailable, so K/D is withheld; watermarks and creator IDs are ignored.
run.personal_combat_native: Personal kills and deaths are attributed from native CS2 HUD signals; watermarks, creator IDs, and player names are ignored.
run.analysis_timed_out: Analysis timed out after processing {seconds:.1f}s of the recording. These are partial results and must not be treated as full-match rounds or K/D.
run.video_decode_partial: The recording repeatedly failed to decode near {seconds:.1f}s. Damaged frames were skipped where possible, but the result is incomplete and must not be treated as full-match rounds or K/D.
run.cs2_model_unavailable: CS2 enemy detection is unavailable; continuing with basic first-person analysis
run.clip_unavailable: Event clip generation is unavailable; static evidence is still retained
run.ocr_fallback: EasyOCR is not installed. Falling back to timer-gap round detection. Run: pip install easyocr.

context.title: Coaching Context Evidence
context.subtitle: Known inputs come only from native CS2 HUD evidence. Unknown inputs are left blank, never guessed from round duration or a video watermark.
context.abstention: Context-dependent pace, buy, rotation, utility and map-position verdicts are withheld whenever their required inputs are unavailable.
context.guard: Context gate — known: {known}; unavailable: {missing}. No unsupported pace, buy, rotation, utility, or map-position verdict is generated.

diagnostics.title: Detection Diagnostics & Corrections
diagnostics.subtitle: Review every personal kill/death claim and reject false detections. Changes immediately rebuild totals, reports and coaching; the exported labels can be used for regression fixtures.
diagnostics.events_help: Checked means the detection is accepted. Uncheck a false positive; missing events remain visible as a limitation and can be added to a future annotation workflow.
diagnostics.add_event_help: Choose the round and enter seconds elapsed since that round started. The user label is kept separate from raw detector output.
diagnostics.accepted_help: Rejecting this event removes it from match totals, reports and coaching without modifying the raw detector output.
diagnostics.summary: Accepted {accepted} of {total} detected personal combat events.
diagnostics.no_events: No correctable personal kill/death detections are available.

overview.partial_result: This is a partial result after a timeout. The starred round count and current kills/deaths do not represent the full match; retry at a lower analysis FPS or with engagement detection disabled.

evidence.title: Evidence Explorer
evidence.no_links: No evidence links in the report.
evidence.clips_help: Each silent H.264 clip includes two seconds before and three seconds after the event.

coach.title: AI Coach
coach.subtitle: Evidence-based coaching suggestions
coach.no_suggestions: No sufficiently reliable first-person moment was detected, so no speculative advice was generated.
coach.first_person_coverage: Evidence cards cover flash, continuous-scope, and confirmed enemy-visible windows. View activity remains descriptive; an engagement card defines a review window and never judges aim quality from one frame.

coach_reasoning.death_heavy: You died {deaths} time(s) but only secured {kills} kill(s) in this round. Your positioning may have been too aggressive or exposed.
coach_reasoning.aggressive: Strong round! {kills} kill(s), no deaths. Your aim and engagement timing were sharp.
coach_reasoning.contact_context: An opponent was first confirmed visible {time:.1f}s into this round. This timestamp only locates the contact event; it is not divided by the observed round duration or used to judge pace.
coach_reasoning.no_combat: No kills or deaths in a {duration:.0f}s round. You may have been too passive or isolated.
coach_reasoning.kd_improving: K/D improving: {early:.1f} early -> {late:.1f} late. You adapted well as the match progressed.
coach_reasoning.kd_declining: K/D declining: {early:.1f} early -> {late:.1f} late. Opponents may have adapted to your playstyle.
coach_reasoning.early_deaths: You died within the first 30 seconds in {count}/{total} rounds ({pct:.0f}%). Early deaths give the enemy team a significant advantage.
coach_reasoning.loss_streak: You had a {streak}-round losing streak. This may indicate tilt or opponents exploiting a pattern.
coach_reasoning.inconsistent: High round-to-round variance: kills range from {min} to {max} (avg {avg:.1f}). Your performance is inconsistent.
coach_reasoning.flash_episode: Continuous flash blindness lasted about {seconds:.1f}s here; this is linked to the exact moment.
coach_reasoning.scope_episode: This continuous scoped hold lasted about {seconds:.1f}s and may have limited peripheral information.
coach_reasoning.engagement_window: An opposing player was detected {time:.1f}s into this round across {samples} sampled frame(s), with an observed span of {span:.1f}s, establishing a contact review window.
coach_reasoning.likely_firefight: An opposing player was detected {time:.1f}s into this round across {samples} sampled frame(s), with an observed span of {span:.1f}s, near {shots} muzzle-flash candidate(s) and {damage} damage-overlay candidate(s); this is marked as a likely fight.
coach_reasoning.native_death: At {time:.1f}s into this round, the native health HUD disappeared for about {seconds:.1f}s after being stably visible, marking a probable POV death.

coach_action.death_heavy: Hold angles from cover. Use utility (flash/smoke) before peeking common angles. Only peek when you have a clear advantage.
coach_action.aggressive: Keep up the crosshair placement. Review positioning after each kill -- do not over-extend.
coach_action.contact_context: Review about two seconds around this frame: whether movement had stopped, the crosshair covered the expected head line, how much of the body was exposed relative to cover, and whether the peek had information, utility, or trade support. Map-pace claims additionally require map, side, spawn, and route evidence.
coach_action.no_combat: Communicate with teammates. Position for trades. If lurking, align timing with team executes.
coach_action.combat_density: Prioritise staying alive over chasing kills. Hold advantageous positions and let opponents make mistakes.
coach_action.kd_improving: Continue warming up before matches to start strong from round 1.
coach_action.kd_declining: Vary your approach between rounds. If you always peek the same angles, opponents will pre-aim them.
coach_action.early_deaths: Prioritise survival in the opening phase. Use safer pathing routes and check corners more carefully.
coach_action.loss_streak: After 2 consecutive lost rounds, take a mental reset. Change your positioning or try a new angle.
coach_action.inconsistent: Focus on consistency. Practice deathmatch for 10 minutes before competitive matches to stabilise aim.
coach_action.flash_exposure: Turn away from incoming flashes and use cover before re-peeking.
coach_action.scope_hold: Unscope periodically to refresh peripheral information and avoid holding one angle too long.
coach_action.engagement_review: Play the contact clip and review whether movement had stopped, the crosshair covered the expected head line, body exposure relative to cover, and whether the peek had information, utility, or trade support. Only enemy visibility is evidenced here; no shot is inferred, and no pace verdict is made.
coach_action.firefight_review: Play the event clip and review pre-aim, first shot, return damage, and disengage/trade phases. Visual signals are candidates and should be confirmed from the clip.
coach_action.incoming_damage_review: A damage-overlay candidate appears without a reliable muzzle-flash candidate. Check whether you were exposed before returning fire and identify the nearest safe retreat path.
coach_action.precontact_fire_review: A muzzle-flash candidate precedes first enemy visibility. Review whether it was justified prefire, a wallbang, or unrelated visual change, and whether the pre-aim point had evidence behind it.
coach_action.immediate_fire_review: A muzzle-flash candidate closely follows first enemy visibility. Review whether movement had stopped before the first shot, crosshair height, and the route back to cover.
coach_action.delayed_fire_review: A muzzle-flash candidate appears later after first enemy visibility. Review whether the delay came from target confirmation, crosshair correction, movement, or occlusion.
coach_action.native_death_review: Play the death clip and review the last safe cover, first exposure, whether the same line was re-peeked, retreat options, and trade potential. The native-HUD transition attributes the POV death, while the clip should confirm the cause.

player_filter.active: Player filter active: only your POV

report_finding.round_truncated: Round did not end before video terminated -- analysis may be incomplete.
report_finding.native_death_detected: Sustained disappearance of the native health HUD confirms a POV death in this round.
report_finding.no_combat: No kills or deaths detected in this round.
report_finding.enemy_tracks: {n} enemy player track(s) active during this round.
report_finding.likely_firefight: {n} enemy-contact window(s) also contained a muzzle-flash or damage-overlay candidate and were marked as likely fights.
report_finding.match_total_kills: Total kills detected across all rounds: {n}.
report_finding.match_total_deaths: Total deaths detected across all rounds: {n}.
report_finding.match_no_combat: No combat events (kills or deaths) detected in the entire match.
report_finding.view_dynamics: View activity {motion:.2f}; stationary-frame share {stationary:.0f}% (describes running and turning, not aim quality).

live_advice.hp_critical: HP critical ({hp}) -- one shot from death
live_advice.action_hp_critical: Fall back to cover immediately. Wait for teammates or hold a defensive angle.
live_advice.action_hp_low: Hold a defensive off-angle. Avoid dry-peeking common positions.
live_advice.action_freeze: Prepare for next round: check economy and plan your buy.
live_advice.action_context_required: Use the minimap, teammate positions, sound, and the round objective before deciding whether to hold or move; one screenshot cannot determine the best action.
live_advice.tip_hp_critical: At {hp} HP, any rifle shot kills you. Stay behind cover and let teammates trade.
live_advice.tip_hp_low: Consider asking a teammate to drop you a weapon or trade positions.
live_advice.tip_armour_low: Armour is low ({armour:.0f}). Refill armour next round and make sure you have a helmet if the economy allows.
live_advice.tip_crosshair_steady: The crosshair is visible; one screenshot cannot establish whether it was stable or whether movement had stopped.
live_advice.tip_crosshair_moving: No crosshair was detected. Scoping, utility switching, HUD settings, or occlusion may cause this, so movement is not inferred from one frame.
live_advice.tip_killfeed: The global kill feed is visible; one screenshot cannot establish the engagement distance or whether the kill happened nearby.
live_advice.tip_killfeed_cautious: Be cautious: a fight just happened. Hold position or rotate safely.
live_advice.tip_money: Check your economy for the next buy round.
live_advice.tip_default: No specific threats detected -- maintain map awareness and check minimap.
live_advice.round_inactive: Round is not active (freeze time or ended)

coach_summary.kd_strong: Match K/D was {ratio:.1f}, with substantially more personal kills than deaths.
coach_summary.kd_low: Match K/D was {ratio:.1f}; prioritise reviewing exposure, retreat cover, and trade conditions before each death.
coach_summary.kd_balanced: Match K/D was {ratio:.1f}, with personal kills and deaths relatively close.
coach_summary.aim_strength: Several multi-kill rounds were detected; review reproducible first-shot and target-transfer sequences in those clips.
coach_summary.positioning_weakness: Several positioning review windows were detected; inspect exposure, cover, and retreat routes.
coach_summary.positioning_drill: Practise counter-stops, short peeks, and returning to cover for 10 minutes per day on a local server.
coach_summary.positioning_focus: Positioning and cover: reduce unsupported exposure and preserve a safe retreat route.
coach_summary.game_sense_weakness: Several evidence-backed game-sense review windows were detected.
coach_summary.game_sense_drill: Watch one or two professional POV demos per week and record contextual timing, route, and utility decisions.
coach_summary.game_sense_focus: Game sense: review timing with map, side, spawn, and team information instead of event seconds alone.
coach_summary.teamplay_weakness: Some evidence windows need review for trade distance, information sharing, and teammate coordination.
coach_summary.teamplay_focus: Teamplay: communicate positions, intentions, and tradeable spacing clearly.
coach_summary.early_death_weakness: Several deaths occurred in the opening portion of rounds; review first exposure and retreat conditions.
coach_summary.early_death_drill: Walk familiar maps and inspect safe routes, common lines, and the nearest cover section by section.
coach_summary.consistency_weakness: Personal kill counts varied substantially between rounds.
coach_summary.consistency_drill: Use a short, fixed pre-match routine for counter-stops, placement, and deathmatch so the training variables stay consistent.
coach_summary.streak_weakness: Personal deaths exceeded kills across several consecutive rounds; review each decision instead of attributing the sequence only to form.
coach_summary.streak_focus: After consecutive difficult rounds, reconfirm economy, positioning, and the team plan.
coach_summary.assessment_solid: Analysed {rounds} rounds. The current evidence shows relatively stable fundamentals; next focus: {focus}.
coach_summary.assessment_growth: Analysed {rounds} rounds. The current evidence contains several improvement windows; prioritise: {focus}.
coach_summary.default_strength: Continue collecting match recordings with clear event evidence.
coach_summary.default_weakness: There is not enough evidence to confirm a major weakness.
coach_summary.default_drill: Continue playing and recording matches for cross-match comparison.
coach_summary.default_focus: Maintain consistency across core mechanics and decisions

combat_unavailable.strength: Native scoreboard reconstruction identified {rounds} rounds reliably.
combat_unavailable.weakness: Personal kills and deaths cannot yet be attributed safely from this HUD.
combat_unavailable.drill: Review the representative first-person keyframes for positioning and angle selection.
combat_unavailable.focus: First-person positioning, crosshair placement, and decision timing.
combat_unavailable.assessment: Detected {rounds} rounds from the native CS2 scoreboard. K/D-based coaching is withheld rather than inferred from unrelated overlays.

personal_kill_unavailable.weakness: Personal kills still cannot be safely attributed from this HUD; native health-HUD transitions support conservative death detection.
personal_kill_unavailable.assessment: Detected {rounds} rounds and {deaths} POV death(s) from native HUD transitions. Personal kills remain excluded from K/D and coaching conclusions.

personal_kill_lower_bound.strength: Three independent POV signals conservatively confirm at least {kills} personal kill(s).
personal_kill_lower_bound.weakness: Personal kills are a lower bound; kills without POV fire, an enemy engagement, and the native local-kill highlight are omitted, so exact K/D is unavailable.
personal_kill_lower_bound.assessment: Detected {rounds} rounds, at least {kills} POV kill(s), and {deaths} POV death(s). Kills are a conservative lower bound, so exact K/D conclusions remain withheld.

first_person_summary.flash_weakness: Flash exposure was substantial in one or more rounds.
first_person_summary.flash_drill: Practise anti-flash turns and re-peek timing with a teammate on common execute routes.
first_person_summary.scope_focus: Refresh peripheral information during long scoped holds.
first_person_summary.engagement_strength: Confirmed enemy-visible windows are now available for first-person review.
first_person_summary.engagement_focus: Use confirmed contact frames to review the preceding and following two seconds for pre-aim, cover, and trade conditions.
first_person_summary.death_focus: Use native-HUD-confirmed death clips to review the last safe cover and the timing of the final exposure.
